consumer_description: Parses markdown wiki-links and constructs directional graph nodes, backlinks, and unresolved target lists.

requirements.statement: Extracts [[Target]], [[Target|alias]], and [[Target#Heading|alias]] links while ignoring fenced code blocks and inline code spans
Normalizes titles by trimming whitespace, lowercasing, and collapsing internal whitespace
Builds de-duplicated directed edges between notes, discarding self-links
Collects unresolved link targets per note when target title is not in the note collection
Computes node degree as the sum of incoming and outgoing unique edges

exports.name: parseWikiLinks
exports.description: Extracts wiki-link objects from markdown text

exports.name: normalizeTitle
exports.description: Normalizes a note title for case-insensitive lookup

exports.name: buildLinkGraph
exports.description: Builds full graph result with nodes, edges, backlinks, and unresolved targets

inputs.description: Array of notes containing id, title, and body markdown

outputs.name: graph
outputs.description: Constructed graph nodes, edges, backlinks, and unresolved targets
